summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Guest Chat Flow (Phase 4). All 17 features tested and passed. Guest page at /guest/abc123 loads directly without login redirect. Room entry screen shows Operoo header, building icon, title, description, and numeric input. Continue button disabled when empty, enabled after typing. Chat interface shows Reception header with Online status and Room number. 2 mock welcome messages display correctly. Guest can send messages (Enter key), auto-reply appears after ~1.5s. Back button returns to room entry. Mobile-first design works on both 390x844 and 1920x1080 viewports.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlaps send button, blocking click events. Users must use Enter key to send messages instead of clicking the send button.
ui_bugs.workaround: Enter key works to submit messages

issues: Emergent badge positioned at bottom-right overlaps the send button area

action_items: Consider adding z-index or repositioning the chat input area to avoid Emergent badge overlap (low priority - Enter key workaround exists)
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent - proper use of data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Guest route correctly configured without auth wrapper in App.js
Chat messages are MOCKED - uses React state only, no backend persistence
Auto-reply is MOCKED - uses setTimeout(1500ms) for simulated response
i18n translations properly implemented for EN and IT languages
inputMode='numeric' correctly set for mobile keyboard optimization
test_credentials: No credentials needed - guest page is public
seed_data_creation: None - all data is mocked in React state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 guest chat flow testing complete. Guest page at /guest/:token loads without auth. Two states: (1) RoomEntry component shown first, (2) Chat component shown after room submit. Messages stored in React state. Auto-reply is setTimeout mock (1.5s). Back button resets to room entry.
